files.text:
CMOS 1.2 V to 3.3 V level shifter
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VDDL vddl 0 1.2
VIN vin 0 PULSE(0 1.2 20n 100p 100p 40n 80n)
XDUT vddl vdd 0 vin out outb astra_027_cmos_dual_rail_level_shifter
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec out_low range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec outb_low range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec out_high range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec outb_high range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec out_low2 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec outb_low2 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec out_high2 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec outb_high2 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec out_low3 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec outb_low3 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 10p 180n
meas tran out_low FIND v(out) AT=10n
meas tran outb_low FIND v(outb) AT=10n
meas tran out_high FIND v(out) AT=45n
meas tran outb_high FIND v(outb) AT=45n
meas tran out_low2 FIND v(out) AT=85n
meas tran outb_low2 FIND v(outb) AT=85n
meas tran out_high2 FIND v(out) AT=125n
meas tran outb_high2 FIND v(outb) AT=125n
meas tran out_low3 FIND v(out) AT=170n
meas tran outb_low3 FIND v(outb) AT=170n
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
